name: tidemark
displayName: Tidemark — Claude Code usage, limits & account switching
description: See how much Claude quota you have left and when it resets. With more than one Claude account, switch between them from the status bar.

commands.title: Save Current Login as an Account

viewsWelcome.contents:
No accounts saved yet.

If you are signed in to Claude Code, save that login as your first account:
[Save Current Login](command:tidemark.captureCurrent)

Already have accounts in a sync repo?
[Set Up Sync](command:tidemark.syncSetup)

[Open the walkthrough](command:tidemark.openWalkthrough)

tidemark.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the active account and remaining quota in the status bar.

tidemark.statusBar.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar to use. Takes effect after a window reload.

tidemark.statusBar.priority.description: Higher numbers sit further from the edge. Takes effect after a window reload.

tidemark.statusBar.showWeekly.description: Include the weekly figure in the status bar as well as the 5-hour window.

tidemark.statusBar.showAccountName.description: Include the active account's label in the status bar.

tidemark.pollIntervalMinutes.description: How often to ask Anthropic for fresh usage figures.

tidemark.idlePollIntervalMinutes.description: How often to look up usage for accounts you are not currently using.

tidemark.staleAfterMinutes.description: After this long without a successful refresh, figures are marked as stale and are not used for auto-failover decisions.

enumDescriptions: Refresh the sign-in tokens of accounts you are not using, so their figures stay current. The account in use is left to Claude Code, which refreshes it itself.
Never refresh a token. Accounts you are not using will show their last known figures once their token expires.
tidemark.refreshPolicy.markdownDescription: Whether this machine may refresh the sign-in tokens of accounts it is not using. `auto` is needed for auto-failover to know how much each account has left. The account in use is never refreshed here — Claude Code owns that one.

tidemark.estimate.enabled.description: When Anthropic's usage figures are unavailable, show a rough estimate from local session logs (always marked with a ~).

tidemark.failover.enabled.description: When the account in use runs out, automatically switch to the account whose weekly quota expires soonest.

tidemark.failover.sessionTriggerPercent.description: Treat the 5-hour window as finished at this percentage used.

tidemark.failover.weeklyExhaustedPercent.description: An account is not a candidate once its week is this percentage used.

tidemark.failover.preferredWeeklyLeftPer.description: After a 5-hour window finishes, prefer an account with at least this much of its week still left.

tidemark.failover.cooldownMinutes.description: Minimum gap between two automatic switches.

enumDescriptions: End other Claude Code sessions on this machine and reload the window so sessions come back on the new account.
End every Claude Code session on this machine and leave reopening to you.
Swap the credentials only. Running sessions keep the old account until they end.
tidemark.restartStrategy.description: What happens to running Claude Code sessions when you switch account.

tidemark.restartGraceSeconds.description: How long a session is given to exit cleanly before it is forced.

tidemark.protectInvokingSession.description: Never end the Claude Code session that asked for the switch.

tidemark.sync.enabled.description: Keep your accounts in an encrypted file in your own private git repository so every machine has them.

tidemark.sync.repository.description: Git remote holding the encrypted bundle, for example git@github.com:you/claude-accounts.git. Use a private repository.

tidemark.sync.autoPushOnChange.description: Push after saving, renaming or removing an account.

tidemark.sync.pullIntervalMinutes.description: How often to pull the bundle. 0 disables automatic pulls.

tidemark.sync.rememberPassphrase.markdownDescription: Keep the sync passphrase in your operating system's keychain instead of asking for it each time this window opens. Needed if you want auto-failover to work without you being there. Off by default — the passphrase is otherwise held in memory only.

tidemark.machineName.description: Name shown to your other machines. Defaults to this machine's hostname.

tidemark.logLevel.description: Detail level in the Tidemark output channel.

walkthroughs.title: Tidemark
walkthroughs.description: See your Claude quota, then add more accounts if you have them.

steps.title: Watch your quota in the status bar
steps.description:
Tidemark reads the login Claude Code is already using, so there is nothing to configure. The status bar shows what is left of your 5-hour window and your week, with a countdown to the next reset.

[Refresh now](command:tidemark.refresh)

steps.title: Add a second account
steps.description:
Save the login you are on, then let Tidemark walk you through signing in to the next one. After that, switching is one click in the status bar.

[Add another account](command:tidemark.addAccount)

steps.title: Optional: carry your accounts between machines
steps.description:
Your accounts can live in one passphrase-encrypted file in a private git repository of your own, so any machine you trust has all of them without signing in again.

[Set up sync](command:tidemark.syncSetup)
